verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party webhooks docs describe real-time outbound HTTP notifications. They cover registering an endpoint, verifying Svix signatures, and handling retries instead of polling the API, which delivers the core of subscribing to events programmatically. The email incident notifications on status.vanta.com do not count toward this story. missing for 10: documented catalog of subscribable event types or per-event filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration that webhooks work as described.
